panels.title: ABOUT
panels.text: A responsive article viewer in plain HTML, CSS and JS. The UI text is German. No build step, no dependencies. `node_modules` was not consulted.

items.text: Shows a list of articles in an overlay. Select an article to read its headline and text.
Loads the articles from `data/articles.json`.
Works on every screen width.
Builds the DOM with fragments, so the browser does few updates.
Sets ARIA attributes dynamically.
Debouncers keep hover from stealing focus.
Run `docker compose build && docker compose up -d`. Then open [http://localhost:8080](http://localhost:8080).
Use any static server on the repo root, for example `python3 -m http.server 8080`. The page fetches `/data/articles.json` by absolute path.
Do not open `index.html` from disk (`file://`). Browsers block ES modules and `fetch()` there.
Opens [http://localhost:8080](http://localhost:8080), served by `nginx:alpine`. It gets `index.html`, `css/main.css` and `js/index.js` (ES modules).
The module script in `index.html` calls `fetchArticles()`. `fetch()` reads `data/articles.json` (id, headline, text) as JSON.
`createArticleButtons()` builds all buttons in one DocumentFragment: one DOM update for all of them.
Holds an aside with the article buttons and an article with headline and text. **Alle Kategorien** opens it. The close button or Escape closes it.
Focus or click shows the article at once. Mouseover waits for a 300 ms debounce.
`aria-hidden` and `aria-inert` follow the overlay and side-menu state. Below 768 px the article list sits behind a side-menu toggle.
Edit `data/articles.json`. Each entry is `{ "id", "headline", "text" }`.
The page creates one button per entry at load time.

`text` goes in as HTML, so `` and `
` work. Put only trusted content there.

readme.hero_alt: article-viewer. No framework was harmed. Vanilla JS, HTML, CSS, ARIA. Stable.

code: docker compose build && docker compose up -d   # then open http://localhost:8080
python3 -m http.server 8080   # no Docker: any static server on the repo root

index.html            markup + the module script that wires everything up
data/articles.json    the articles: id, headline, text (HTML)
js/articles/          fetch, button factory, button event listeners
js/aria/              aria attributes for the overlay and its buttons
js/utility/           overlay state, side menu, debouncer, Escape key
css/                  variables, layout, components, utilities
fonts/                Roboto Regular + Bold
Dockerfile            nginx:alpine image that serves the folder
docker-compose.yml    port 8080 -> 80, mounts the folder into nginx
